about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Spiced Ful Medames with Tahini and Soft Egg
recipes.summary: Warm mashed broad beans with lemon, cumin and a soft-boiled egg.
steps: Warm the beans with the garlic, cumin and 100ml water for 8 minutes, until hot, then mash roughly with a fork.
Stir in the lemon juice, half the oil and salt.
Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks soft, then peel.
Spoon the beans into bowls, drizzle with tahini and the remaining oil, and add the tomato, parsley and an egg.
Serve with warm flatbread.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Brown Rice Breakfast Bowl with Miso Greens and Egg
recipes.summary: Leftover rice topped with miso-glazed greens and a jammy egg.
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks jammy, then peel.
Warm the sesame oil and cook the kale for 4 minutes, until wilted and bright.
Whisk the miso and mirin with 2 tbsp water and stir through the kale until glossy.
Heat the rice until steaming, then divide between bowls and top with kale, egg, sesame and nori.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Savoury Mince on Toast with Poached Egg
recipes.summary: A comforting British breakfast of spiced beef mince on buttered toast.
steps: Brown the mince with the onion until no pink remains.
Stir in the carrot, tomato paste, stock and worcestershire sauce and simmer for 12 minutes, until thick and rich.
Poach the eggs for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Butter the toasted bread until the slices are glossy, then spoon over the mince and add an egg.
notes: Food safety: cook the mince until 75°C in the centre and no pink remains.
Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rice Porridge with Poached Pear
recipes.summary: Creamy rice pudding style porridge with warm cinnamon and soft pear.
steps: Simmer the rice, milk and cinnamon stick, stirring, for 20 minutes, until the rice is tender and creamy.
Melt the butter and cook the pear for 5 minutes, until soft and golden.
Remove the cinnamon, stir in half the maple syrup, and spoon into bowls.
Top with pear, walnuts and the remaining syrup.
notes: Use oat milk for a dairy free version.

recipes.title: Pesto Scrambled Eggs on Sourdough
recipes.summary: Soft scrambled eggs ribboned with basil pesto and cherry tomatoes.
steps: Whisk the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter and add the tomatoes for 2 minutes, until blistered.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat for 3 minutes, until just softly set.
Fold in the pesto and serve on toasted sourdough with rocket.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Mushroom Congee with Soy Cashews
recipes.summary: Plant-based rice porridge with seared mushrooms and crunchy soy cashews.
steps: Simmer the rice, stock and ginger for 45 minutes, stirring now and then, until the grains burst and the porridge is thick.
Sear the mushrooms in a dry pan until golden, then add the soy sauce until glossy.
Toast the cashews in a pan until golden.
Ladle the congee into bowls and top with mushrooms, cashews, spring onion and sesame oil.
notes: Vegan. Use tamari for gluten free.

recipes.title: Dutch Baby Pancake with Roasted Berries
recipes.summary: A puffed oven pancake served with warm roast berries and yoghurt.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C with a 24cm ovenproof frying pan inside.
Blend the eggs, flour, milk and sugar until smooth.
Melt the butter in the hot pan, pour in the batter and bake for 18 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Warm the berries with the honey for 3 minutes until they release their juices.
Serve the pancake with berries and yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Turkish Egg and Yoghurt with Chilli Butter (Cilbir)
recipes.summary: Poached eggs on garlicky yoghurt with sizzling paprika butter.
steps: Mix the yoghurt and garlic with a pinch of salt and let it come to room temperature.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Melt the butter with the paprika and chilli until foaming and deep red.
Spoon the eggs onto the yoghurt, drizzle with the butter until it pools, and scatter with dill. Serve with toast.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Beetroot and Feta Rye Toast
recipes.summary: Earthy roast beetroot, creamy feta and walnuts on seeded rye.
steps: Toast the rye until crisp.
Mash the feta with the oil until spreadable.
Spread the feta on the toast, and layer with beetroot and rocket until generously piled.
Top with walnuts and a drizzle of honey.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Spicy Tofu Scramble with Black Beans
recipes.summary: A smoky vegan scramble loaded with capsicum, beans and fresh herbs.
steps: Soften the onion and capsicum in the oil for 5 minutes, until tender.
Crumble in the tofu with the spices and cook for 5 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Stir through the beans and warm until hot.
Warm the tortillas and serve the scramble inside, topped with coriander.
notes: Vegan and gluten free.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Coconut and Mango
recipes.summary: Make-ahead oats in coconut milk topped with fresh mango.
steps: Stir the oats, coconut milk, yoghurt and honey together.
Chill overnight, until the oats are soft and creamy.
Spoon into bowls and top with mango, toasted coconut and lime zest.
notes: Plus overnight chilling.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Soba Noodle Breakfast Bowl with Soft Egg and Dashi
recipes.summary: Warm noodles in a light dashi broth with an egg and spring onion.
steps: Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, until the whites are set, then peel.
Cook the soba in boiling water until tender, about 4 minutes, then drain.
Heat the dashi with the soy and mirin until steaming.
Divide the noodles into bowls, pour over the broth and top with egg, spring onion and nori.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.
Check the soba label for gluten if needed.

recipes.title: Garlic Mushroom Frittata with Thyme
recipes.summary: A thick baked frittata studded with browned mushrooms and thyme.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Fry the mushrooms in the oil until golden and the liquid cooks off.
Add the onion, garlic and thyme and soften for 4 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and cream with salt and pour over the vegetables in an ovenproof pan, adding the gruyere.
Bake for 18 minutes, until set in the centre and golden on top.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Baked Coconut Rice Pudding Breakfast with Cardamom
recipes.summary: A baked, creamy rice breakfast scented with cardamom.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C. Mix the rice, coconut milk, milk, sugar, cardamom and sultanas in a baking dish.
Bake, stirring once, for 50 minutes, until the rice is tender and the pudding is creamy.
Rest for 5 minutes and scatter with pistachios.
notes: Plus 5 minutes resting.
Vegetarian and gluten free.

recipes.title: Roast Tomato and Ricotta Breakfast Tart
recipes.summary: A buttery puff pastry tart filled with ricotta, tomatoes and basil.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Score a 2cm border on the pastry and prick the middle.
Mix the ricotta with the egg, thyme and salt and spread inside the border.
Top with tomatoes and oil and bake for 28 minutes, until puffed and golden and scatter with basil.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Berry Bircher with Grated Apple
recipes.summary: Soaked oats and grated apple with berries and a nutty finish.
steps: Combine the oats, apple, juice and yoghurt.
Chill overnight, until the oats have softened.
Top with berries and almonds.
notes: Plus overnight chilling.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Filipino Garlic Rice with Tomato and Fried Egg
recipes.summary: Fragrant garlic fried rice with a runny egg and fresh tomato.
steps: Fry the garlic in the oil until golden and crisp, then lift out half.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 4 minutes, until hot and lightly toasted.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set.
Serve the rice topped with the egg, tomato, spring onion and the crisp garlic.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Ginger Sweet Potato Pancakes with Maple Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Fluffy spiced pancakes made with mashed sweet potato.
steps: Whisk the sweet potato, eggs and milk until smooth, then stir in the flour, baking powder and spices.
Melt a little butter in a pan and cook ladles of batter for 3 minutes, until bubbles form, then flip for 2 minutes until golden.
Mix the yoghurt and syrup and serve over the stacks.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burrito with Chorizo, Beans and Avocado
recipes.summary: A hand-held burrito packed with spicy chorizo, eggs and avocado.
steps: Cook the chorizo until crisp and the fat runs.
Add the beans, then pour in the whisked eggs and stir for 3 minutes until just set.
Warm the tortillas, fill with the eggs, avocado, cheddar and salsa, and roll up.
notes: Food safety: cook the chorizo to 75°C and the eggs until fully set.

recipes.title: Rye Porridge with Cardamom Stewed Apples
recipes.summary: A hearty Nordic porridge with soft cinnamon apples.
steps: Simmer the oats, crumbs and milk for 12 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Cook the apples with the butter, sugar and cardamom for 8 minutes, until soft and syrupy.
Spoon the porridge into bowls and top with the apples.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Spinach Savoury Breakfast Crepes
recipes.summary: Thin buckwheat style crepes filled with garlicky mushrooms and spinach.
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk to a thin batter.
Cook the mushrooms and garlic in butter until golden, then wilt in the spinach.
Cook ladles of batter in a lightly oiled pan for 1 to 2 minutes each side, until the edges lift and set.
Fill each crepe with vegetables and gruyere and fold.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Raisin and Almond Breakfast Pudding
recipes.summary: Warm oat and almond pudding sweetened with raisins.
steps: Simmer the oats, milk and raisins for 10 minutes, until the oats are soft.
Stir in the cinnamon and honey.
Top with toasted almonds.
notes: Vegetarian; vegan with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Spinach and Paneer Breakfast Bhurji
recipes.summary: Soft scrambled paneer with spinach, tomato and chilli.
steps: Heat the ghee and fry the cumin seeds until they crackle.
Cook the onion and chilli for 5 minutes until soft, then add turmeric and tomato for 3 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the paneer to warm through and serve with warm roti.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Smashed Avocado with Dukkah Eggs on Seeded Toast
recipes.summary: Smashed avocado topped with dukkah-crusted soft eggs.
steps: Toast the mixed seeds, cumin and sesame in a dry pan until fragrant, then crush coarsely with salt for a dukkah.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and oil.
Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks soft, then peel.
Toast the bread until crisp, then spread with avocado and top with halved eggs and dukkah.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Hearty Lentil and Kale Soup with Smoked Paprika
recipes.summary: A thick soup of brown lentils, kale and paprika for a cold day.
steps: Soften the onion and carrots in the oil for 6 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the garlic and paprika for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer for 25 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
Add the kale for 3 minutes until wilted, then finish with the vinegar.
notes: Vegan and gluten free.

recipes.title: Roasted Tomato and Red Capsicum Soup
recipes.summary: A velvety soup of slow-roasted tomatoes and red capsicum.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast the tomato, capsicum, onion and garlic in the oil for 40 minutes, until blistered and caramelised.
Blend with the stock and vinegar until smooth.
Reheat gently and season. Serve with basil.
notes: Vegan and gluten free.
Food safety: Reheat leftovers until steaming hot right through.

recipes.title: Chicken and Sweet Corn Egg Drop Soup
recipes.summary: A silky Chinese style soup with sweet corn and ribbons of egg.
steps: Simmer the stock with the ginger and corn for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, until opaque and cooked through.
Stir the cornflour with 3 tbsp water and add, simmering until slightly thickened.
Stream in the eggs while stirring until ribbons form, then add soy and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C and until white all the way through.

recipes.title: Smoky Black Bean Soup with Lime and Avocado
recipes.summary: A hearty Latin American soup topped with creamy avocado.
steps: Soften the onion in oil until translucent, then cook the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the beans and stock and simmer for 25 minutes, until the beans break down.
Blend half the soup and stir it back in.
Add the lime juice and serve with avocado and coriander.
notes: Vegan and gluten free.

recipes.title: Creamy Potato and Leek Soup with Crispy Bacon
recipes.summary: Smooth potato soup finished with crisp bacon pieces.
steps: Soften the leek and onion in the butter for 8 minutes, until very soft.
Add the potato and stock and simmer for 18 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Blend until smooth and stir in the cream.
Fry the bacon until crisp and scatter over with the chives.
notes: Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and well done.

recipes.title: Tom Kha Style Mushroom and Coconut Soup
recipes.summary: A fragrant coconut soup with galangal, lemongrass and mushrooms.
steps: Simmer the stock, lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves for 10 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk and mushrooms and simmer for 6 minutes until tender.
Season with soy sauce and lime juice and top with chilli.
notes: Vegan. Fish out the aromatics before eating.

recipes.title: Turkish Yoghurt Soup with Rice and Mint (Yayla)
recipes.summary: A tangy warm yoghurt soup with tender rice and mint butter.
steps: Simmer the rice in the stock for 15 minutes, until soft.
Whisk the yoghurt, yolk and flour in a bowl, then temper in a ladle of hot stock.
Stir the mixture back into the pot over low heat for 5 minutes, until slightly thickened. Do not boil.
Sizzle the butter with the mint and chilli until foaming, then drizzle over.
notes: Vegetarian if made with vegetable stock.

recipes.title: Pearl Barley and Mushroom Soup with Dill
recipes.summary: A warming Central European mushroom and barley soup.
steps: Sweat the onion and carrots in butter for 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the barley and stock and simmer for 40 minutes, until the barley is tender.
Stir in the sour cream and dill.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Silky Ramen-Style Chicken Broth with Greens
recipes.summary: A clean, savoury chicken broth with noodles, soy egg and greens.
steps: Cover the wings with water and bring to a gentle simmer, skimming the scum, then add onion, garlic and ginger and cook for 2 hours, until the broth is rich and golden.
Boil the eggs for 6.5 minutes, then peel and soak in the soy and mirin until tinted.
Strain the broth and season.
Cook the noodles until tender and wilt the bok choy in the broth.
Ladle over the noodles, halve the eggs onto the top and add spring onion.
notes: Food safety: simmer the chicken until cooked through at 75°C; cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.
Plus 1 hour soaking the eggs.

recipes.title: Watermelon, Feta and Mint Salad with Lime
recipes.summary: A cooling summer salad of watermelon and salty feta.
steps: Toss the watermelon with the onion, lime juice and oil until coated.
Crumble the feta over and scatter with mint and pistachios.
Serve at once, while the watermelon is still cold.
notes: Vegetarian and gluten free.

recipes.title: Roasted Beetroot, Orange and Goat Cheese Salad
recipes.summary: Earthy beetroot with orange and creamy goat cheese on rocket.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Wrap the beetroot in foil and roast for 45 minutes, until a knife slides in easily.
Peel and wedge the beetroot.
Whisk the oil and vinegar and toss with the rocket.
Arrange with the beetroot, orange, cheese and walnuts.
notes: Vegetarian and gluten free.

recipes.title: Asian Pear and Cabbage Slaw with Gochujang Dressing
recipes.summary: A crunchy, sweet and spicy slaw with fresh pear and gochujang.
steps: Whisk the gochujang, vinegar and sesame oil until smooth.
Toss the cabbage, pear, carrot and spring onion with the dressing.
Serve topped with sesame seeds.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad with Anchovy Crumbs
recipes.summary: Crisp cos with grilled chicken and a creamy anchovy dressing.
steps: Toast the breadcrumbs in oil until crisp and golden.
Pan-fry the chicken for 6 minutes each side, until golden and 75°C inside, then slice.
Mash the anchovy and garlic and whisk in mayonnaise, mustard and lemon juice.
Toss the lettuce with dressing, top with chicken and crumbs.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C in the thickest part.

recipes.title: Lentil, Cucumber and Herb Salad with Preserved Lemon
recipes.summary: A fresh lentil salad with herbs and bright preserved lemon.
steps: Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes, until tender but holding their shape, then drain and cool.
Whisk the oil and vinegar.
Toss the lentils with the cucumber, herbs, preserved lemon, onion and dressing.
notes: Vegan and gluten free.

recipes.title: Noodle Salad with Peanut Lime Dressing
recipes.summary: Cold rice noodles with crunchy veg and a zesty peanut lime dressing.
steps: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes, until tender, then drain and rinse cold.
Whisk the peanut butter, lime juice, fish sauce, chilli sauce and 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with julienned vegetables and herbs, drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with peanuts.
notes: Contains peanuts and fish.

recipes.title: Grilled Pear, Halloumi and Rocket Salad
recipes.summary: Charred pears with salty halloumi on peppery rocket.
steps: Grill the pears cut side down in a hot pan for 3 minutes, until charred.
Fry the halloumi for 2 minutes each side, until golden.
Toss the rocket with oil and vinegar and top with peach, halloumi, honey and pistachios.
notes: Vegetarian and gluten free.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chickpea and Roast Vegetable Salad
recipes.summary: Warm chickpeas with roasted zucchini, capsicum and lemon.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast the vegetables in 2 tbsp oil for 25 minutes, until tender and charred.
Add the chickpeas for the last 10 minutes.
Toss with lemon juice, oregano, parsley and the remaining oil.
notes: Vegan and gluten free.

recipes.title: Cucumber Yoghurt Salad with Toasted Cumin and Chilli
recipes.summary: A cooling Indian-style kachumber with creamy yoghurt.
steps: Toast the cumin seeds in a dry pan until fragrant.
Mix the vegetables, yoghurt, chilli and coriander.
Season and top with the cumin.
notes: Vegetarian and gluten free.

recipes.title: Warm Green Bean and Tomato Salad with Fried Shallots
recipes.summary: A West African inspired warm bean salad topped with crisp shallots.
steps: Boil the beans for 4 minutes, until just tender.
Fry the onion and tomato in oil for 4 minutes, until soft.
Toss with beans, lemon juice and salt and sprinkle with fried shallots.
notes: Vegan and gluten free.
